info.description:
End-to-end regression tests for the Demo Test shop API (auth, catalog, cart, checkout/orders).

Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner (or: newman run). Requests depend on each other, so do not reorder them. Needs the app running on {{baseUrl}} with the seeded admin account.
info.name: Demo Test API - QA Collection
